notes: Item 19 is clearly present and fully readable. All sections (A, B, C) extracted. Section B second quartile lists two entries as 'Franchise #12' — one is likely a typo for Franchise #13, but values are extracted as presented. Section C tenure-bucket cohort_name mapping is approximate: the schema does not have a dedicated 5-10 year bucket, so open_60_plus_mo was used for both 10+ year and 5-10 year cohorts; the 1-5 year cohort was mapped to open_12_24mo as the closest available option. All outlet counts are franchise-level (not territory-level). Gross Revenues represent top-line revenue, not profit.
